categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: intelligent power distribution equipment manufacturing, new energy business including photovoltaic power generation and construction, and energy storage business. It also engages in offshore wind power installation and operation through its marine construction segment. Additionally, it produces cable protection pipes and related electrical equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in intelligent power distribution, including integrated primary and secondary fused pole-mounted circuit breakers, standardized feeder terminals (FTU), station terminals (DTU), and environmentally friendly gas-insulated ring main units. It employs digital and automated control systems for power distribution and integrates photovoltaic and energy storage technologies such as lithium iron phosphate batteries and hybrid inverters. Manufacturing involves both make-to-order and stock-based production to meet diverse customer needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include provincial and municipal power companies such as State Grid and Southern Power Grid subsidiaries, large state-owned general contractors, and new energy sector clients. The company serves industries related to power distribution, renewable energy generation, and offshore wind power installation. Its markets are primarily in the electric power sector, renewable energy developers, and industrial and residential power users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in China, with significant revenue generated from the East China and Central China regions, and growing presence in North China and other areas. It is expanding its overseas footprint in the energy storage market through overseas subsidiaries and branch offices. Major operations and headquarters are located in Jiangsu Province, with subsidiaries across multiple Chinese provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power supply chain, manufacturing intelligent power distribution equipment and providing turnkey photovoltaic power station construction and operation services. It also engages in energy storage product development and sales, and offshore wind power installation services, positioning itself as a system solution provider in smart grid and renewable energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing intelligent power distribution technologies, expanding photovoltaic and offshore wind power construction capabilities, and developing diversified energy storage products. The company emphasizes R&D in standardized and digitalized power distribution equipment, environmentally friendly gas-insulated switchgear, and hybrid inverters. It aims to enhance product competitiveness and market share through continuous innovation and integration of smart grid and renewable energy technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of intelligent power distribution equipment, photovoltaic power generation and construction services (EPC), offshore wind power installation services, and sales of energy storage products. The company also earns income from power sales via self-owned photovoltaic power stations and provides after-sales and operational services. It follows a make-to-order and turnkey project delivery model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a competitive position in the intelligent power distribution equipment manufacturing industry in China, with recognized technology and product certifications. It faces competition from leading domestic and international smart grid and energy storage companies, especially in the overseas energy storage market where it is still building brand recognition. Its integrated business model across power distribution, new energy, and storage sectors strengthens its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 443 million, a 65.66% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in intelligent power distribution and photovoltaic businesses. Despite revenue growth, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 145 million, improved by 15.04% compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets exceeded RMB 2.15 billion, with ongoing investments in fixed assets and project construction. It is in a growth phase with expanding business scale but faces profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive intelligent power distribution solutions integrating design, R&D, manufacturing, construction, and services. Its products feature advanced integration of primary and secondary systems, digitalization, and environmental friendliness. It differentiates through strong R&D capabilities, multiple patented technologies, and the ability to provide turnkey renewable energy projects and offshore wind power installation services. The company aims to be a leading system solution provider in smart grids and new energy sectors, offering reliable, efficient, and innovative products and services.
